scripts.start:all: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web/backoffice && npm install --prefix web/public && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix web/backoffice" "npm run start --prefix web/public" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health && npm run swagger --prefix api"
scripts.test:all: concurrently "npm run test --prefix api" "npm run test:headless --prefix web/backoffice" "npm run test:headless --prefix web/public"
